Description_Text: This dataset contains carbon emissions data for various countries worldwide. The dataset includes information on total emissions, coal, oil, gas, cement, flaring, other sources, and per capita emissions. It spans from the year 1750 to 2020, covering a wide range of countries with varying levels of economic development. The data is suitable for analyzing country-specific carbon emissions trends and identifying areas for improvement in reducing greenhouse gas emissions. This dataset was used in a study that analyzed the performance of high-income countries in reducing emissions and found that they are not meeting their fair-share carbon budgets.
Reference_Description: The Global Carbon Project (GCP) has published global and national fossil CO₂ emissions estimates since 2001—evolving from simple republications to refined methodologies—providing the 2021 fossil CO₂ dataset in absolute and per-capita forms with JSON metadata and a developing file documenting the source of each data point.
